raw_text: Professional ESP32-S2/S3 Arduino/PlatformIO AT21CS01/11 driver. Headers only in `include/AT21CS/`; implementation in `src/`; `examples/common/` is not part of the library. Minimal examples: single-device and multi-device CLI. No board-specific pin defaults; no steady-state dynamic allocation; no library logging; no `delay()` except bounded protocol timing/bit windows. No unbounded loops; every wait has timeout/deadline. Single-wire timed, MSb-first; discovery handshake after reset/power-up; preserve ACK/NACK error phase; during t_WR keep SI/O high and bounded ready polling. AT21CS11 High-Speed only; reject Standard Speed cleanly. Explicit states/transitions: `UNINIT`, `PROBING`, `INIT_CONFIG`, `READY`, `BUSY`, `DEGRADED`, `OFFLINE`, `RECOVERING`, `SLEEPING`, `FAULT`. All fallible APIs return `Status`; `const char* msg;` No silent failures; don't disguise validation/precondition errors as transport failures. `Version.h` auto-generated; do not edit. Source of truth: `library.json`; generated by `scripts/generate_version.py`. Do not modify `docs/AT21CS01_AT21CS11_complete_driver_report.md` technical content unless maintainer explicitly requests. Versioning: MAJOR breaking API, MINOR compatible features, PATCH fixes/docs/refactors. Naming: members `_camelCase`; methods/functions, locals/params, config fields `camelCase`; constants `CAPS_CASE`.
